guns.text: She sponsored and passed measures restricting firearm possession in certain circumstances and banning firearm marketing to children.
guns.quote: Rebecca has introduced and passed bipartisan bills that strengthen gun safety laws.

abortion.text: She authored laws creating legal and privacy protections for abortion providers and patients in California.
abortion.quote: She authored a bill that was signed into law and enacted the very day Roe was overturned to create a strong legal shield for California abortion providers and patients.

tax.text: Rubay calls for cutting spending, lowering the cost of living, and reducing the state gas tax.
tax.quote: In the Assembly I'll push for a comprehensive review of our infrastructural expenditures and practices so that we can upgrade our roads and reduce the gas tax.

wages.text: Rubay opposes raising the minimum wage (such as SB-525's healthcare wage), arguing it raises costs on those least able to afford it.
wages.quote: Raising minimum wages also increases the costs of goods and services which in turn has the greatest impact on those who can least afford it.

safety.text: Rubay opposes defunding police and calls for restoring full funding to local law enforcement.
safety.quote: He opposes efforts to defund the police and supports restoring adequate funding to local law enforcement agencies.

sentencing.text: Rubay criticizes lenient prosecution and early-release policies and calls for stronger accountability for repeat offenders.
sentencing.quote: Rising crime rates, lenient prosecution, and early release policies have endangered neighborhoods, and he calls for stronger accountability for repeat offenders.
